policies.sentence: The instructor runs similarity and plagiarism tools on submissions, including AI-generated solutions and code found online.
The instructor uses AI detectors such as Turnitin on student submissions.
Work flagged as less than 5% AI-generated can be ignored.
The instructor does not use AI detectors or actively look for AI use, because detectors are unreliable.
Instructors and TAs can easily recognize AI-generated work, and students will be caught.
The instructor checks homework to enforce the AI policy, and the ban is strictly enforced.
AI tends to produce similar code for different users, so copied code gets flagged.
Students should not rely on AI so heavily that their submission is no longer their own.
